title: HiCP2GAN: a plug and play foundation model-based GAN for Hi-C enhancement.
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于预训练Hi-C基础模型作为判别器的GAN框架HiCP2GAN，用于增强低分辨率Hi-C染色质互作图，直接涉及三维基因组空间互作建模与AI方法，与本课题高度相关。
abstract: The 3D organization of chromatin shapes gene regulation and cellular function, and Hi-C has become the primary technique for mapping chromatin interactions genome-wide. However, high-resolution data remain costly and scarce, leaving many studies with sparse contact maps that limit downstream analysis. Deep learning methods, especially generative adversarial networks (GANs), have shown promise for enhancing low-resolution Hi-C data, but most existing GAN-based approaches rely on custom discriminators trained from scratch, which can yield unstable training and limited generalization. Hi-C foundation models pretrained on large-scale data capture rich, transferable representations of chromatin structure, yet their use as discriminators within adversarial enhancement frameworks had not been explored. We introduce HiCP2GAN, a plug-and-play GAN that employs a pretrained Vision Transformer-based Hi-C foundation model as its discriminator. The discriminator was pretrained on 118 million Hi-C patches across diverse species and cell types, providing biologically meaningful gradients for adversarial supervision. The framework is generator-agnostic: any compatible Hi-C resolution enhancement architecture can serve as the generator, enabling fair comparison across methods. The encoder phase of the foundation model was adapted as a discriminator backbone, finetuning the first few layers from the input while freezing the deeper transformer layers to preserve pretrained knowledge while allowing task-specific adaptation. Experiments across various cell lines show that HiCP2GAN outperforms traditional GAN-based methods in most settings and improves the reconstruction quality and biological reproducibility of existing Hi-C enhancement models in most evaluated cases. HiCP2GAN is publicly available at https://github.com/OluwadareLab/HiCP2GAN.
abstract_zh: 染色质的3D组织塑造了基因调控和细胞功能，而Hi-C已成为全基因组范围内绘制染色质相互作用的主要技术。然而，高分辨率数据仍然昂贵且稀缺，导致许多研究仅有稀疏的接触图谱，限制了下游分析。深度学习方法，尤其是生成对抗网络（GANs），在增强低分辨率Hi-C数据方面显示出潜力，但大多数现有的基于GAN的方法依赖于从头训练的自定义判别器，这可能带来训练不稳定和泛化能力有限的问题。在大规模数据上预训练的Hi-C基础模型捕获了丰富、可迁移的染色质结构表征，但其在对抗性增强框架中作为判别器的应用尚未被探索。我们引入了HiCP2GAN，一种即插即用的GAN，采用基于预训练Vision Transformer的Hi-C基础模型作为其判别器。该判别器在跨多种物种和细胞类型的1.18亿个Hi-C片段上进行了预训练，为对抗性监督提供了生物学上有意义的梯度。该框架与生成器无关：任何兼容的Hi-C分辨率增强架构都可以作为生成器，从而支持方法间的公平比较。基础模型的编码器阶段被适配为判别器骨干，从输入微调前几层，同时冻结较深的Transformer层，以保留预训练知识并允许任务特定适应。跨多种细胞系的实验表明，HiCP2GAN在大多数设置中优于传统的基于GAN的方法，并在大多数评估案例中提高了现有Hi-C增强模型的重建质量和生物学可重复性。HiCP2GAN公开可用，网址为https://github.com/OluwadareLab/HiCP2GAN。
